C0091.title: Browser Plugin Hijacks Traffic: Baidu Sues Operator and Wins Compensation
C0091.summary: Shanghai Zhengkai Information Technology operated the “New Media Manager Plus” browser plugin, which inserted links into Baidu search pages and redirected users to pages operated by Zhengkai. Baidu sued for unfair competition. The court found that the inserted links interfered with Baidu’s search service and ordered Zhengkai to pay 800,000 yuan in economic losses plus 30,000 yuan in reasonable expenses.
